name: Registration of Commonwealth Citizens

requirements.blocker_text: 5 or more consecutive years' residence in Jamaica.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 consecutive years of residence in Jamaica.

requirements.blocker_text: Good character, evidenced by a clean police record.

sources.title: Jamaica Information Service (JIS) -- Registration of Commonwealth Citizens: a distinct fast-track for citizens of Commonwealth countries with 5+ consecutive years' residence and good character, Form R3, fee JMD 15,000 / USD 260

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 JIS sourced. This is the concrete structural answer to whether Jamaica's Commonwealth-realm membership shortens the path to citizenship for Commonwealth nationals: it does, via a dedicated registration route (Form R3) that is procedurally distinct from ordinary naturalisation (Form N1, jm_citizenship_naturalisation.json) and does not carry naturalisation's newspaper-publication or 4-Jamaican-born-reference requirements. Both routes share the same 5-year residence figure, but registration is a lighter-weight statutory mechanism reserved for Commonwealth citizens specifically, reflecting Jamaica's Commonwealth-realm status rather than treating all foreign nationals identically.
